title: Large Language Models Cannot Reliably Detect Vulnerabilities in JavaScript: The First Systematic Benchmark and Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper measures systematic evaluation and dataset biases in existing vulnerability detection benchmarks (which lead to underestimation or overestimation of LLM capabilities) by performing ablation studies that compare model performance using snippet-level versus project-level inputs, and strict CWE ID matching versus semantic equivalence-class matching.
